observations.title: Cast through Epic Fight animation
observations.player_action: Cast an Iron's spell with the compatibility mod active; hold a configured staff for its variant.
observations.outcome: Spellcasting uses Epic Fight-compatible animations, including staff-specific poses.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: A cast animation does not prove a spell completed or spent mana. Use Iron's native successful-cast/cancel signal; guarding and rolling can cancel rather than finish casting.

observations.title: Interrupt casting with an Epic Fight action
observations.player_action: Perform a supported guard, roll or other configured combat skill during casting.
observations.outcome: The spell can be cancelled rather than leaving incompatible animations active.
conditions: Confirm installed 2.6.0 cancellation and cooldown behavior against both mod versions.
